value.rationale: All consecutive patterns of length m occur equally often on average under the uniform null, yet their covariances with a fundamental weighted rank statistic have sharp, uniquely attained extremes for all m and n. The exact endpoint/descent decomposition explains the mechanism and distinguishes same-descent-count patterns, providing structural information beyond finite computations or special cases.
